verdict.rationale: The filing portal's published entry is a standard credential account ('Sign In' / 'Create an Account') with self-service password recovery, which a remote human can complete with no biometric liveness, in-person visit, or mailed PIN. The evidence never mentions MFA, so the 'credential MFA' element of the story is unsubstantiated. missing for 10: any documentation of an MFA factor (TOTP/SMS/email) on sign-in, an explicit statement that no in-person or mailed-PIN identity proofing applies, independent or hands-on corroboration of the sign-in flow.
